title: Violent Gangster  is Convinced That Laws Don’t Apply To Him
description:
On October 23rd, 2022, Officers were dispatched in reference to an unwanted subject. While searching the suspect’s car, cops found a number of intoxicants. On their way to the jail, the suspect kept threatening the officers. The man was charged with battery to a peace officer, resisting arrest and criminal trespass to property. He was also issued citations for DUI, Expired DL, operating Uninsured Vehicle and license not on person.
